title: Pure Fire Fist
summary: Pure Brotherhood of the Fire Fist and Fire Formation build spanning Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters alongside generic staples. Fire Fist monsters Set Fire Formation Continuous Spells and Traps straight from the Deck and send them to the GY to fuel searches, revivals, and board control—until Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eagle removes their send costs entirely.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fire Formation - Tenki searches any Level 4 or lower Beast-Warrior from the Deck (grabbing Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Elephant, Bear, Ram, Spirit, or Raven) while staying face-up to pay Fire Fist costs.

Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Elephant sends a face-up Fire Formation you control to the GY to Special Summon a Fire Fist from your hand, and shuffles a Fire Formation from your GY into the Deck to search any Level 5+ Fire Fist (Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Panda or Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eland).

Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Spirit (Level 3 Tuner) revives a Level 3 FIRE monster with 200 or less DEF (Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Rooster or Leopard) on Normal Summon to make Level 6 Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Horse Prince.

summary.title: Opening: Fire Formation - Tenki + Fire Fist Monster
steps: Activate Fire Formation - Tenki to search Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Elephant, Normal Summon Elephant, and send Tenki to the GY to Special Summon Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Raven (or Ram) from the hand.
Link Summon Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eagle using Elephant and Raven; Raven triggers on leaving the field to Set Fire Formation - Domei (or Fire Formation - Tensu) directly from the Deck.

While Eagle points to a monster, your Fire Fist effects no longer require sending Fire Formations from the hand or field to the GY: use Elephant in the GY (or Eagle's bounce of a Fire Formation) to search Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Panda and Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eland.
Activate Fire Formation - Domei to Ritual Summon Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eland, triggering Panda to Special Summon itself from the hand and revive a Fire Fist from the GY.

summary.title: Eagle's Cost Bypass & Liang Peak
summary.text: Normally, Fire Fist monsters must send 1 or 2 face-up Fire Formation Spells/Traps you control to the GY to activate their effects. While Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eagle is on the field, you can activate Fire Fist monster effects without sending Fire Formations from your hand or field to the GY—turning Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Bear (destroy a monster), Gorilla (destroy a Spell/Trap), Rooster (swap a Fire Formation), and Eland (negate a monster effect) into free activations every turn. Fire Fortress atop Liang Peak also accumulates Fire Fist Counters every time a Fire Fist is Normal or Special Summoned, removing 2, 6, or 10 counters to grant battle immunity, search a Beast-Warrior, or Special Summon a Beast-Warrior from the Deck or Extra Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eland (Level 6 Ritual) Sets a Fire Formation from the Deck or GY and sends a face-up Fire Fist or Fire Formation (or 0 under Eagle) to negate any opponent's monster effect.

Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Swan (Level 8 Fusion) burns on Special Summon and sends a face-up Fire Formation during the Battle Phase to destroy an opponent's card, while Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King (Rank 4) Sets a Fire Formation and negates all non-Beast-Warrior monsters on the field.

Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Cardinal shuffles 2 cards from the opponent's field or GY into the Deck, Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Peacock steals an opposing monster when it attacks, and Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen non-target banishes a card on the field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Fire Formation - Domei Ritual Summons Eland and sends itself from the field to the GY to revive a Fire Fist; Fire Formation - Ingen Fusion Summons a Beast-Warrior Fusion (Swan) and recovers a Fire Fist from the GY when it leaves the field.
Fire Formation - Tensu grants an additional Normal Summon of a Beast-Warrior each Main Phase.
Ultimate Fire Formation - Sinto is a searchable Counter Trap that negates and destroys any Spell or Trap activation while you control both a Fire Fist monster and a Fire Formation Spell/Trap.
